projects.name: resume-screener-api
projects.description: AI-powered resume analysis using LLM and semantic matching. Analyzes resumes against job descriptions and returns detailed match scores, skill gaps, and improvement suggestions.

projects.name: CommentToxicity
projects.description: This Jupyter Notebook demonstrates a machine learning pipeline for detecting toxic comments. It includes data preprocessing, model training, evaluation, and deployment using an interactive web interface.

projects.description: GAN implementation in TensorFlow for generating fashion images — includes generator/discriminator architecture, training pipeline, and saved models (FashionGAN).
